extension.description: Measures how you write your code, file by file, and reports it to your Certimens space. No text leaves your machine without your say-so.
view.title: Certimens
view.name: Writing agent
configuration.title: Certimens
configuration.exclude: Paths that are not measured: dependencies, build output, generated files. An excluded file never creates a file on the engine.
capability.untrustedWorkspaces: The agent watches typing and runs nothing from the project.
capability.virtualWorkspaces: Measurement covers the files of a project opened from disk.
